title: Public officer's spouse not barred from having business interest—SEC exec

blocks.text: The law governing ethical standards for public officials does not prohibit their spouses from having business interests or companies linked to their spouses from entering into contracts with government agencies, an official of the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said.
